factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for halfmoon.
factors.value_notes: The reviewed species accounts describe southern California distribution, kelp/rock habitat and seasonal occurrence, but do not provide a numeric preferred SST or validated thermal response curve. Historical reports of northward occurrence during warm periods do not validate the configured 14-22 °C range or 16-20 °C ideal. Keep values unchanged and mark needs_source.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for halfmoon.
factors.value_notes: The Smithsonian Tropical Research Institute species account reports 0-44 m on rocky bottoms and algal beds; Aquarium of the Pacific describes use high in the water column over rocks and at mid-depth over kelp. This supports shallow reef/kelp habitat, but the configured 1-30 m outer band excludes part of the reported depth range and the 3-25 m ideal is not a measured preference curve. Fish vertical position is not seafloor depth.

text.day: Full daylight when Pacific gamefish actively hunt.
